{"notes": "Visit 1, left at 1:15. I don't know who placed which domino, so these notes rest only on what I heard and saw.

Table state: one unbroken dark chain runs from the start at the right, curving left to about x=10.5. I saw no gaps and no stray pale dominoes. I can't tell whether it has reached the nose yet, and the belly (stroke 2) hasn't started.

Hana: Made the sketch, which Jack praised. She states the plan clearly and in a useful way. At 1:00 she corrected the topology: the line runs tail, back, nose, and the belly branches off at the nose. This was relevant because the push starts at the tail. She is checking the nose join. Strong on clarity and planning. I haven't seen her hands-on work directly, so I can't credit her for the chain. Watch whether she delivers the nose join.

Sofia: Staged on the belly and is waiting for the top line to reach the nose before starting, which is sensible sequencing. She politely redirected Jack to avoid two people on one stroke. Good collaboration and judgment. Execution is not yet observed, so check next visit.

Jack: Enthusiastic and supportive (praised Hana). But he jumped to the belly and told Sofia to take the tail end of the belly, which didn't match the plan. Two teammates corrected him, and he hadn't acknowledged it by 1:00. Now assigned to watch the tail end for gaps. Check that he took the redirect and does it.

Omar: Not seen or heard at all this visit. I have no basis to rate him. Find out what he's working on and ask him privately next visit.

No ratings yet."}
